page.layout: One blank page of paper; no printed text blocks. Only stains, shading and a dark mark at the right edge (a ring-shaped smudge) are visible.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf with no printed text, no running head, no page number, no catchword and no signature. The darker shading at the left and right edges and the ring-shaped smudge near the right edge are stains or show-through, not print, and are therefore not transcribed.
